title: AuditBundleManifest
description: Schema for evidence bundle manifest.json produced by build_evidence_bundle.py

source_root.description: Root directory from which source files were collected

files.description: Records for files that were processed (included, redacted, or excluded)

rejected.description: Records for files that were rejected before inclusion

redactions_path.description: Relative path to redactions log within the bundle

checksums_path.description: Relative path to checksums file within the bundle

request_path.description: Relative path to request (file contents) within the bundle

path.description: Path relative to source_root, forward-slash separated

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest; empty string when file was not hashed

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes; 0 when file was not read

kind.description: Disposition of this file in the bundle

redaction_reason.description: Reason for redaction (e.g. 'secret_pattern:github_token_ghp'); null if not redacted

exclusion_reason.description: Reason for exclusion (e.g. 'symlink', 'path_escape', 'file_not_found', 'secret_pattern:...''); null if not excluded
